title: Coral and the Garden Revisited
author: August Underhill
blurb: Sable Sandoval, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
